learning_outcomes.text: Defines material types, atomic and crystal structures; explains the relationship between structure and properties.
Interprets the electrical properties and band structure of electronic, conductive, semiconductor, and insulating materials.
Explains and analyzes electrical properties such as electron and hole mobility, conductivity, and dielectric behavior.
Explains the structure and operating principles of basic semiconductor devices such as diodes, LEDs, and transistors.
Explains the magnetic, superconducting, and optical properties of materials and establishes the relationship of these properties with technological applications.
Analyzes different material properties to select appropriate materials for specific engineering applications.

syllabus_topics: Conductivity and hole and electron mobility
